description: Arch-keyed shared device-constant table consumed by the local-label metric ontology and the occupancy / cache / timing composition resolvers. Each constant is an object {value, source, provenance}. source is one of live_device_query | vendor_whitepaper | cuda_programming_guide | derived | deferred_no_live_evidence. sm_86 (RTX 3090 Ti, GA102) carries settled values with documented provenance. sm_120 (RTX 5060 laptop, Blackwell) is DEFERRED: every constant uses source deferred_no_live_evidence and a provenance string starting with 'sm_120_deferred_no_live_evidence:'; arch-invariant constants (32-byte sector, 32-thread warp) carry their value, all others are null. This satisfies the cross-arch-retain + no-live-claim contract.

sector_size_bytes.provenance: CUDA C Programming Guide: 32-byte L1/L2 cache sector for all current architectures including CC 8.6.

warp_size.provenance: CUDA C Programming Guide: warp size is 32 threads on all NVIDIA architectures including CC 8.6.

l1_capacity_bytes.provenance: CUDA C Programming Guide G.10.1 (Compute Capability 8.6): per-SM unified L1 data cache / texture / shared-memory budget is 128 KiB = 131072 bytes; from tools/cache_predictor/l1_static_card_table.json l1tex_capacity_bytes.

l2_capacity_bytes.provenance: Live device query on the local RTX 3090 Ti (cudaDeviceProp.l2CacheSize = 6291456 bytes = 6 MiB); from tools/hrd_profiler/device_properties.json l2_capacity_bytes.

num_l2_slices.provenance: sm_86_deferred_no_live_evidence: prior table asserted 6 one-MiB L2 slices from a repo manifest, but GA102 public documentation describes twelve 32-bit memory controllers each paired with 512 KiB L2. The predictor must not consume this topology value until the intended unit is proven or renamed.

sm_count.provenance: Live device query on the local RTX 3090 Ti: cudaGetDeviceProperties(...).multiProcessorCount = 84 (GA102, sm_86); from tools/hrd_profiler/ga102_peak_constants.json sm_count.

registers_per_sm.provenance: CUDA C Programming Guide (Compute Capability 8.6): 64K = 65536 32-bit registers per SM.

max_registers_per_thread.provenance: CUDA C Programming Guide: maximum 255 32-bit registers per thread (CC 8.6).

register_allocation_unit.provenance: CUDA C Programming Guide (Compute Capability 8.x): register allocation unit size is 256 registers.

warp_allocation_granularity.provenance: CUDA C Programming Guide (Compute Capability 8.x): warp allocation granularity is 4.

shared_mem_per_sm_bytes.provenance: CUDA C Programming Guide (Compute Capability 8.6): maximum 100 KiB = 102400 bytes shared-memory-per-block carveout; from tools/cache_predictor/l1_static_card_table.json carveout_max_shared_bytes.

shared_mem_allocation_unit_bytes.provenance: CUDA C Programming Guide (Compute Capability 8.x): shared-memory allocation unit is 128 bytes.

reserved_shared_memory_per_block_bytes.provenance: CUDA C Programming Guide (Compute Capability 8.x) / cudaDevAttrReservedSharedMemoryPerBlock: the driver reserves 1024 bytes of shared memory per thread block; this reservation is added to the per-block shared-memory allocation when computing the shared-memory occupancy limit, matching NCU's launch__occupancy_limit_shared_mem accounting.

max_warps_per_sm.provenance: CUDA C Programming Guide (Compute Capability 8.6): maximum 48 resident warps per SM.

max_blocks_per_sm.provenance: CUDA C Programming Guide (Compute Capability 8.6): maximum 16 resident thread blocks per SM.

peak_dram_bytes_per_s.provenance: Derived from the 384-bit memory bus x 21 Gbps GDDR6X effective rate: 21.0e9 transfers/s * (384/8) bytes = 1.008e12 B/s = 1008 GB/s; from tools/hrd_profiler/ga102_peak_constants.json dram_bytes_per_s.

base_sm_clock_mhz.provenance: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3090 Ti published specification (Ampere GA102): base SM clock 1560 MHz; from tools/hrd_profiler/ga102_peak_constants.json base_sm_clock_mhz.

boost_sm_clock_mhz.provenance: Live device query on the local RTX 3090 Ti: cudaDeviceGetAttribute(cudaDevAttrClockRate) = 1890000 kHz = 1890 MHz; from tools/hrd_profiler/ga102_peak_constants.json boost_sm_clock_mhz.

memory_clock_mhz.provenance: RTX 3090 Ti GDDR6X effective 21 Gbps -> 10502 MHz pin clock (vendor spec; the live cudaDevAttrMemoryClockRate query reads 10501 MHz, within rounding of the published 21 Gbps effective data rate).

sector_size_bytes.provenance: sm_120_deferred_no_live_evidence: arch-invariant 32-byte sector / 32-thread warp; sector size carried because it is architecture-invariant, but no live RTX 5060 laptop device query was run this session.

warp_size.provenance: sm_120_deferred_no_live_evidence: arch-invariant 32-byte sector / 32-thread warp; warp size carried because it is architecture-invariant, but no live RTX 5060 laptop device query was run this session.

l1_capacity_bytes.provenance: sm_120_deferred_no_live_evidence: no live RTX 5060 laptop (Blackwell sm_120) device query; do not assume the sm_86 L1 budget carries to Blackwell.

l2_capacity_bytes.provenance: sm_120_deferred_no_live_evidence: no live RTX 5060 laptop (Blackwell sm_120) device query for L2 capacity.

num_l2_slices.provenance: sm_120_deferred_no_live_evidence: no live RTX 5060 laptop (Blackwell sm_120) device query for L2 partition count.

sm_count.provenance: sm_120_deferred_no_live_evidence: no live RTX 5060 laptop (Blackwell sm_120) device query for SM count.

registers_per_sm.provenance: sm_120_deferred_no_live_evidence: no live RTX 5060 laptop (Blackwell sm_120) device query; register file size per SM not asserted.

shared_mem_allocation_unit_bytes.provenance: sm_120_deferred_no_live_evidence: no live RTX 5060 laptop (Blackwell sm_120) device query for shared-memory allocation unit.

reserved_shared_memory_per_block_bytes.provenance: sm_120_deferred_no_live_evidence: no live RTX 5060 laptop (Blackwell sm_120) device query for the driver-reserved per-block shared memory.

max_warps_per_sm.provenance: sm_120_deferred_no_live_evidence: no live RTX 5060 laptop (Blackwell sm_120) device query for max resident warps per SM.

max_blocks_per_sm.provenance: sm_120_deferred_no_live_evidence: no live RTX 5060 laptop (Blackwell sm_120) device query for max resident blocks per SM.
